# Bullet Physics

For the squishy 3D Axo (`apple/AxoSquishy`): a soft body with pressure inside it. Vendored,
unmodified, from https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3 at
`d3afe76132fc76b0f9b2359cbaef47a3766e7fbb` (3.27): `src/LinearMath`, `src/BulletCollision`,
`src/BulletDynamics`, `src/BulletSoftBody` and the two `src/bt*Common.h` headers, without their
CMake and premake files. zlib licence: `LICENSE`.
